turns.learner: Hello. Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are in present, please?
turns.tutor:
Look: Anna is kind. Anna is one person, so we use "is".
Rule: use am with I, is with he, she and it, and are with you, we and they.
Right: We are late. Wrong: We is late.
